chunks: And he was asked about a Christian who is on a journey while he is with the Muslims, and then he dies.
He said: “A Muslim should not wash him, nor bury him, nor show him any honor, and should not stand by his grave, even if he were his father.”
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a Christian dies while traveling among Muslims?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the death of a Christian while traveling among Muslims. It states that a Muslim is not to perform the funerary acts of washing, burial, or grave attendance for him, even in the case of close kinship.
